title: Print Glass Panels
description: Add Panel overlay construct to print/ with anchor+offset positioning, frosted glass background via two-pass rasterize/blur/tint pipeline matching ui-glass-panel.
summary: Fixed glass panels not looking glassy: root cause was expl3 l_ (group-local) offset/anchor registers reverting to 1cm defaults after \end{Panel}, so rasterization cropped empty cream margin instead of TOC content. Freeze anchor/x/y into per-panel shipout macro at capture_end. Stronger blur, removed noise grain. All demo panels moved to y=5cm over page content. Verified: report page 2 shows frosted blur of TOC numbers/dots through panel.
